construction.implementation_origin: New isolated reference implementation with explicitly synthetic fixtures

shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version, fixture_label, now, question, knowledge_base, products, events, limit. Events describe one implicit user.
shared_schema.products: Unique id, nonempty name and category, popularity in [0,1].
shared_schema.knowledge_base: Unique id, title, verbatim answer and unique product_ids referencing the catalog.
shared_schema.events: product_id referencing catalog, kind browse or purchase, timezone-aware ISO at no later than now.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status, fixture_label, faq, behavior. FAQ has status, answer, source_ids, product_ids, confidence, reason. Behavior has cold_start and recommendations with product_id, name, score, components, faq_source_ids.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate function guards input and handoffs, checks exact grounded FAQ result and recomputes expected output; rejects unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers and invalid references.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated FAQ status, article source_ids, grounded catalog product_ids
cross_stage_handoffs.effect: Only cited article product_ids receive a 1.0 recommendation boost; recommendation provenance carries the same source_ids. Abstention hands off empty IDs and gives zero boost.

behavior.retrieval: Lowercase ASCII alphanumeric token sets excluding a documented small stopword set; query-token coverage against title plus answer. Best article wins; ties use article id. Minimum coverage 0.5.
behavior.grounding: Answer copied verbatim from one cited article. Confidence denotes lexical coverage, not calibrated factual certainty. Unsupported queries explicitly abstain.
behavior.ranking: Per product: 0.1 * popularity + sum(event_weight * 2 ** (-age_days / 30)) + grounded FAQ boost. Browse weight 1; purchase weight 3. Components rounded to 8 decimal places, then summed and rounded. Score descending then product id ascending.
behavior.cold_start: No events means cold_start true; rank by popularity plus FAQ context. Empty catalog returns empty recommendations.
behavior.history_semantics: Every supplied event is counted, including repeated events and purchases; recommendations can include previously purchased products.
behavior.errors: File, JSON, schema and invocation errors yield one JSON object with status error and exit 2; success yields one JSON object and exit 0.

excluded: Live LLM or optional model callable

test_outcomes.cli: passed: single JSON object, status ok, exit 0
test_outcomes.error_cli: passed: missing file, malformed JSON, invalid schema and incorrect arguments return status error and exit 2
